messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — we're planning a targeted config push to the runtime pools in eu-west tonight 23:30 UTC. This will include a model pin for redwood-v2-small and a kernel patch. Expected customer-facing window: 23:30–00:30 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy queued: runtime-config-eu-2026-03-21. Canary group: 5% traffic on dedicated-gpu-01. Rollout steps: canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on 3 consecutive canary request errors.

sam: Thanks. Can we draft the statuspage blurb now? I want to get it scheduled 20m before start.

marta: Yup. Draft below — keep short. Pls annotate if missing legal bits.

marta: ```Scheduled maintenance: We will apply a runtime configuration update and model pin for the EU region on 2026-03-21 23:30 UTC. Short user impact (up to ~5m request retries) may occur during canary. Services should remain available; we will update this page if broader impact is detected: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/xxxx```

julia: LGTM. Add note about canary rollback criteria and fallback variant. Suggest: "Requests will automatically fall back to redwood-v2-small-fallback if errors exceed thresholds."

ops_sre: Operational checklist: preflight smoke run on canary instances (curl /health -> 200), preserve KV cache, monitor p99 latency and 5xx rate. Rollback if 5xx > 0.5% sustained 3m or p99 latency +50% vs baseline.

emily: Customer email snippet (short):

emily: Subject: Planned maintenance — EU inference runtime (Mar 21, 23:30 UTC)

emily: Body: "We will perform a brief runtime update in EU on Mar 21 at 23:30 UTC. Most requests will be unaffected; a small number may see transient retries. If you rely on pinned model versions, we've pinned redwood-v2-small for the window. We'll post updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/"

sam: Nice. Can we include the rollback logic in the internal thread too so support can triage quickly?

marta: Internal rollback snippet (for ops playbook):

marta: ```Rollback conditions: - Canary 5xx rate > 0.5% for 3m - Canary p99 latency >= baseline*1.5 for 3m - Error patterns indicating tokenization or output corruption - Any customer-reported regressions flagged as P1 via support channel
Rollback action: - Pause rollout to 0% - Re-pin traffic to redwood-v2-small-stable - Notify customers via status page + support DM list - Open incident channel if >10% traffic affected```

support-bot: Reminder scheduled: post statuspage update 2026-03-21T23:10:00Z (20m before).

julIa: Typo in my earlier msg — confirming: fallback variant name is redwood-v2-small-fallback (matches model catalog).

sam: One more ask — add a short FAQ line for customers who use Dedicated: "Dedicated pools are not affected by this runtime config unless explicitly scheduled."

marta: Added. Final signoff? @sam, @julia, @ops_sre please react with :thumbsup: if ready.

ops_sre: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

julia: :thumbsup: 

emily: I'll schedule the statuspage and the customer email blast (low priority recipients only).

marta: Great. If canary looks clean we'll proceed to 25% at +10m, otherwise rollback per playbook. Keep this thread for live updates.

deploybot: Canary succeeded (5m): 0.03% 5xx, p99 latency +8%. Proceeding to 25% in 2 minutes.

marta: Noted. Posting statuspage now (scheduled update).

support-bot: Statuspage posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864209999 — scheduled publish at 2026-03-21T23:10:00Z

emily: Email queued to low-priority list; send time 23:05 UTC.

marta: Live note — moving to 25% rollout. Monitor for 10m.

deploybot: Rollout to 25% complete. Canary window extended +10m for latency observation.

ops_sre: Seeing a small spike in open file descriptors on one canary host, investigating. Noting as FYI.

marta: If that host shows memory/turbo anomalies, we'll exclude and continue; no customer notice unless errors rise.

ops_sre: Excluded host and resumed. No customer impact observed.

marta: 25% window clean. Proceed to 50%.

deploybot: Rollout to 50% complete. No rollback triggered.

sam: Posting short Slack update to #customers: "Maintenance completed successfully in canary, continuing staged rollout. No customer-facing impact detected."

emily: Sent.

marta: 100% rollout finished at 00:05 UTC. No rollback required. Closing thread and incident stub.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864209999 — final note: Maintenance completed, no widespread customer impact.
